citation.title: Non-iterative structural topology optimization using deep learning
citation.authors: Baotong Li, Congjia Huang, Xin Li, Shuai Zheng, Jun Hong

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract says the two-stage GAN predicts conductive heat-transfer topologies with negligible per-design computation after training on classical optimization outputs.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: The accessible abstract gives no numerical classical-versus-ML runtime ratio.
claim.alternatives: The abstract also says the predicted topology is an accurate estimate of optimized outputs.
